title: 第2260章 破阵时间第2259章 相信你的眼光
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 莫凡没有说话，只是心念一动，身边又多出一道身影。
是风长卿。
梦雨蝶跟风长卿同时看到对方，都微微愣了一下。
他们都已经看出对方现在的处境和身份。
他们之前的身份、地位相当，一个是飘渺神宫宫主，一个是瑶光神宗宗主，都是七星宗门的最高掌权者。
现在他们已经不是宫主、宗主，他们都是莫凡的随从。
他们的身份已经毫无区别了。
在对视两眼的时候，他们的眼神还有几分同病相怜的意味。
两人没有说话，只是垂手站在莫凡身边。
“莫凡，你现在手下有两个顶级主神了，你高兴吗？”叶泠音搂着莫凡的胳膊，还使劲地摇晃了两下。
她现在已经能很自然地挽着莫凡的胳膊了，不再那么羞涩。
“呵呵，其实身边有你和浅月两个普通主神，我就很高兴了。如果不是为了对付大慈恩禅寺和青虹剑宗，我不会把风长卿和梦雨蝶收为随从。”
莫凡说的是实话。
他把风长卿收为己有，是看在褚绛雪的面子上。
杀了风长卿，会在褚绛雪心中留下心结。
父女关系已经断了，但血缘关系还在。
放掉风长卿，不可能。
风长卿对褚绛雪所做的事情，围杀莫凡的事情，不会那么容易过去。
但是一直把风长卿囚禁在始元戒世界，又有点浪费资源。
毕竟，风长卿是一个顶级主神。
莫凡把梦雨蝶收下，就纯粹是为了对付青虹剑宗。
他的精血和实力都还没恢复，逆鳞劫变还要将近两个月才能施展。
但时间不等人，青虹剑宗现在已经有所行动，如果再不出手屠灭，说不定就让他们逃走了。
只有一个风长卿还不够，把梦雨蝶也算上才更保险，让青虹剑宗没有任何逆袭翻盘的可能。
叶泠音的脑袋靠在莫凡肩膀上，用闷闷的声音说道：“莫凡，你身边现在有两个顶级主神，我能帮你做的事情就少了。”
在此之前，莫凡身边修为最高的是她和云浅月，莫凡遇到什么危险，她们能给莫凡提供最大的帮助。
但现在莫凡手下多了风长卿和梦雨蝶，实力更强，莫凡也就不那么需要她们了。
这让叶泠音感觉有些失落。
莫凡捏了一下叶泠音精致无瑕的脸颊，柔声说道：“泠音，不需要你帮我做多少，你一直在我身边就好了。”
叶泠音猛然抬头，眼中闪着亮光，“真的？”
看着她的样子，莫凡笑了。
叶泠音现在性情现在改变了很多，以前她都是很文静、沉稳，现在也开始有小女人的样子，像云浅月一样学会黏人了。
“当然是真的。”
听到莫凡和叶泠音的对话，风长卿、梦雨蝶神色变得复杂。
是大慈恩禅寺和青虹剑宗给了他们一条活路。
如果不是为了对付那两个宗门，他们就没有机会成为莫凡的随从，很可能是被莫凡斩杀。
content_en:
Mo Fan didn't say anything, just thought, and another figure appeared next to him.
It's Feng Changqing.
Meng Yudie and Feng Changqing saw each other at the same time and were slightly stunned.
They have all seen each other's current situation and identity.
They had similar identities and positions before. One was the master of the Piaomiao Shrine, and the other was the master of the Yaoguang Divine Sect. They were both the highest leaders of the Seven Star Sect.
Now they are no longer palace masters or sect masters, they are all Mo Fan's followers.
There is no difference between their identities.
When they looked at each other, there was a hint of sympathy in their eyes.
The two of them did not speak, but stood beside Mo Fan with their hands down.
"Mo Fan, you now have two top gods, are you happy?" Ye Lingyin hugged Mo Fan's arm and shook it twice.
She can now hold Mo Fan's arm naturally and is no longer so shy.
"Haha, in fact, I am very happy to have you and Qian Yue, two ordinary gods, by my side. If it were not for the purpose of dealing with Daci'en Temple and Qinghong Sword Sect, I would not have accepted Feng Changqing and Meng Yudie as my followers."
Mo Fan is telling the truth.
He took Feng Changqing as his own because of Chu Jiangxue's face.
Killing Feng Changqing will leave a knot in Chu Jiangxue's heart.
The relationship between father and daughter has been severed, but the blood relationship remains.
It is impossible to let go of Feng Changqing.
What Feng Changqing did to Chu Jiangxue and the siege of Mo Fan would not be easy.
But keeping Feng Changqing imprisoned in the world of Shiyuan Ring is a bit of a waste of resources.
After all, Feng Changqing is a top god.
Mo Fan accepted Meng Yudie purely to deal with the Qinghong Sword Sect.
His essence, blood and strength have not yet recovered, and it will take nearly two months for the reverse scale calamity transformation to be performed.
But time waits for no one. Qinghong Sword Sect has already taken action. If they don't take action to kill them, they might be allowed to escape.
Only one Feng Changqing is not enough, it is safer to include Meng Yudie, so that Qinghong Sword Sect has no possibility of counterattack and comeback.
Ye Lingyin leaned her head on Mo Fan's shoulder and said in a muffled voice: "Mo Fan, there are two top gods around you now, so there are less things I can do for you."
Before that, she and Yun Qianyue were the ones with the highest cultivation level around Mo Fan. Whenever Mo Fan encountered any danger, they could provide him with the greatest help.
But now that Mo Fan has Feng Changqing and Meng Yudie under his command, they are stronger, and Mo Fan doesn't need them that much.
This made Ye Lingyin feel a little disappointed.
Mo Fan pinched Ye Lingyin's delicate cheek and said softly: "Lingyin, I don't need you to do much for me. I just want you to be by my side."
Ye Lingyin suddenly raised her head, her eyes shining brightly, "Really?"
Looking at her look, Mo Fan smiled.
Ye Lingyin's temperament has changed a lot now. She used to be very quiet and calm, but now she has begun to look like a little woman, and she has learned to be clingy like Yun Qianyue.
"Of course it's true."
After hearing the conversation between Mo Fan and Ye Lingyin, Feng Changqing and Meng Yudie's expressions became complicated.
It was Daci'en Zen Temple and Qinghong Sword Sect that gave them a way to survive.
If it were not for dealing with those two sects, they would not have the chance to become Mo Fan's followers, and they would probably be killed by Mo Fan.
